met_analysis:
The Depression over Jharkhand and adjoining Gangetic West Bengal moved west-northwestwards with a speed of 18 kmph during past 06 hours and lies centered at 1130 hrs IST of today, the 14th August, 2026, over Jharkhand, near latitude 23.3°N and longitude 85.3°E, close to Ranchi (Jharkhand), 80 km south of Hazaribagh (Jharkhand), 130 km east-northeast of Jashpurnagar (Chhattisgarh), 150 km east-southeast of Daltonganj (Jharkhand) and 210 km east of Ambikapur (Chhattisgarh). It is very likely to continue to move west- northwestwards across Jharkhand & adjoining north Chhattisgarh and weaken into well marked low pressure area during next 06 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Firozpur, Muzaffarnagar, Fatehgarh, Daltonganj, centre of Depression over Jharkhand, Digha & thence southeastwards to Eastcentral Bay of Bengal.
The Shear Zone roughly along Lat. 23°N across central & adjoining north Peninsular India between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle and upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 70°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhoodat 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southwest Rajasthan adjoining Pakistan between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The north-south trough from northwest Rajasthan to northeast Arabian sea across Gujarat at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
